name: U-Net trained on UrbanSARFloods (18 flood events)
trained: Kaggle T4, 100 epochs, paper settings (CVPRW 2024); best epoch 95, val F1 flooded-any 0.80, flooded-open 0.82, flooded-urban 0.25
note: Maps standing water at image time. On Valencia the reference also counts drained flood traces, which this model does not map.
